description: An architecture is a sequence of >= 1 layers; sequence length is UNBOUNDED. Each layer is (op, width, residual). Global completeness over the infinite space follows from the certified depth cutoff (see docs/THEORY.md).
notes: All per-layer quantities are exact integers so dominance tests and certificates are bit-exact. Accuracy = acc_min + floor((acc_max-acc_min)*cap/c_sat) below saturation, acc_max at/above saturation, which makes accuracy a strictly increasing function of capacity below c_sat and exactly representable in integer arithmetic.
